title: Signage development examples
slide_intent: Teach designers to compare the scale of a venue name against the available height of a narrow identification banner.
strategic_value: Weston Park can make the venue legible from farther away or give the parent institution a separate position, depending on the sign’s job.
demonstration: Two placements repeat the same yellow banner and façade. A large rotated venue mark fills the first. The second reduces the mark and adds a seal beneath it.
practical_value: Test the large single identifier against the two-mark arrangement at the intended viewing distance.

content_islands.name: Single venue mark
content_islands.spec: On the left façade view, rotate the Weston Park mark along the tall banner and give it most of the vertical space.

content_islands.name: Venue and parent marks
content_islands.spec: Keep the banner in the same location in the second view. Reduce the rotated mark and use the freed space for the Sheffield Museums seal.
